fusions.name: Pegging Shaft
fusions.desc: Looses a thorn-headed shaft at one enemy within 10 tiles for 28 damage that ignores armour, rising to 2 times that at full reach. The shaft takes root and holds the target [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Quiver of Thorns
fusions.desc: Looses 3 thorns in a spread, each dealing 3 damage with a 35% chance to leave its target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; a kill restores one.

fusions.name: Fletcher's Sapling
fusions.desc: Roots a sapling where you stand for 20 seconds. It shoots thorns at enemies within 6 tiles, dealing 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bodkin Tip
fusions.desc: Your plant damage cannot be resisted, and you regenerate 1 health a second.
